As we mentioned, in Rel-15, the CSI-RS active window is for channel buffer, that is why the P/SP CSI-RS is assumed to be always active. Now does the proposal imply that some UE may not need to buffer the channel for future CSI calculation (e.g. AP CSI report triggered later)? Then we wonder which UE implementation can fully release the memory for channel information after a time window.
